digest.component_or_area: LLM structured parsing retry and failure handling
propositions: When a prompted structured parse exhausts OUTPUT_RETRIES in _pai_structured, the raw LLM reply text is currently discarded on failure and is not replayable for diagnosis.

A new opt-in config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir (resolved on LLMConfig via _llm_str with REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR env precedence) enables writing timestamped artifacts containing the final reply, model id, contract name, and attempt count to a local directory.

The artifact write occurs best-effort immediately before the terminal raise in _pai_structured's prompted branch; if the write fails, the original parse error is raised unchanged to prevent masking the root cause.

Artifact rotation keeps at most 20 newest artifacts per directory by mtime to prevent unbounded disk growth on unattended hosts; the default unset value preserves byte-for-byte today's behavior with zero writes.
